posts.title: One Agent Is Nice, Nine Are a Team: A Talk from TYPO3camp Berlin 2026
posts.description: At TYPO3camp Berlin 2026 I talked about how I run coding agents in parallel across nine repositories with herdr. It is one way of doing it, not the way, and most of what made it work were a few fairly boring rules.

posts.title: Calendar Mirror: Getting Home Assistant Calendars Onto an Echo Show
posts.description: Home Assistant can read calendars from almost anywhere but has no way to push them back out to an external calendar with real create-and-delete sync. Calendar Mirror is the integration I built to close that gap - one-way, automatic, and now working with both Google Calendar and CalDAV.

posts.title: Marking Dependent Devices in Home Assistant: No Native Way, So Here Is What I Built
posts.description: Home Assistant has no built-in way to say "this entity is expected to go unavailable because its socket is switched off." Labels plus the Spook integration close that gap: disable the dependent devices when the socket goes off, and they drop out of the recorder and the UI for free.
